_about: Stick-figure talking-head ad (example, 2026-10-06). Hook = separate clip, body = Omni base + extends. Used by stick/plan.py; rules in .claude/skills/stickman-talking/SKILL.md

voices.boy: Pleasant, warm, friendly adult male voice (about 30 years old, NOT a child's voice), smooth and likable, like a popular friendly podcast host talking to a friend. Never harsh, never shouting, never aggressive, never sarcastic.
voices.girl: Pleasant, warm, friendly adult female voice (about 28 years old, NOT a child's or teen's voice), smooth and likable, like a popular friendly podcast host talking to a friend. Never harsh, never shrill, never sarcastic.
voices.expert: Pleasant, warm, confident mature male voice (about 45 years old), calm authority of a friendly relationship expert, likable and engaging. Never harsh, never preachy, never sarcastic.

mood_line: Tone: {MOOD} Lively, natural facial expressions that follow the meaning of the words; smile only where the words are happy, otherwise an engaged, expressive face. Eyebrows lifted and softly arched, never slanted down toward the nose.
_moods: projects/<id>/moods.json {step: mood} - one short tone per piece by its meaning (review: livelier, relevant emotions, no constant grin). Never gestures, never quoted phrases.

characters.boy: The character is an adult man (about 30) drawn in a simple minimalist cartoon style.
characters.girl: The character is an adult woman (about 28) drawn in a simple minimalist cartoon style.
characters.expert: The character is an adult man (about 45) drawn in a simple minimalist cartoon style.

_characters: Always in every prompt: a child-looking character + relationship words ('partner', 'obsessed') got the girl hook moderation-blocked (2026-10-06).
_sharpness: check.py: new part / chain base Laplacian sharpness. Boy calibration: e1 0.59, e2 0.57, e3 0.48, e4 0.41 (e4 visibly mushy). User complained only at 0.41 (boy run 1 e4); 0.48 had no complaint -> fail < 0.45. Re-running an extend does not fix blur (it is depth-driven).
_extend: girl: extends with only the adult-character line were moderation-blocked twice (relationship words + child-looking figure); the base prompts (with the adult voice line) passed -> extends carry the voice line too.
context: Context: a light, everyday conversation - an adult {GENDER} casually talking about dating and texting with {POSS} adult partner and a self-help app {PRON} uses.
_context: girl c1_e1 was moderation-blocked twice (relationship words + child-looking figure) until this line was added.
_hook: v2 2026-10-06 after the user's verdict on the girl run: face = energy in eyes/brows/voice/gestures, mouth only shapes words, smile only after the last word; body moving all the time (generic gestures, never tied to a phrase); 0.3 s breath between sentences.
_brows: hook v2 men: 'confident excitement' -> brows slanted down = angry ; girl was fine. Brows-up line in hook and mood line.
body_hook_default: Body: moving all the time like an engaging storyteller - lively hand gestures that illustrate the words (an open palm toward the viewer, a hand to the chest, a small explaining gesture), shifting weight, a slight lean toward the viewer on the answer. No pointing finger, no big cheerful shrugs.

body_hook.expert: Body: moving all the time, every movement meaningful like a relationship expert explaining on camera - during the question a questioning open-palm gesture toward the viewer with a slight head tilt; during the answer calm, purposeful explaining gestures: both hands shaping an idea in front of the chest, palms up, a measured nod. Eyes stay open and friendly. No winking, no squinting, no hand on the hip, no fidgeting, no random arm swings, no pointing finger.

_body_hook: expert hook3: generic 'storyteller' body line -> winks, hand on hip, random moves = 'irrelevant and strange'. Per-character body lines with movements tied to the MEANING of each sentence (never quoting phrases) + banned random moves; keep the amount of movement.
delivery_hook: Delivery: the first sentence is an intriguing question with a clear rising question intonation, curious and hooking. The second sentence is the answer, said with confident excitement, like revealing something that really works.
delivery_body: Delivery: lively, expressive storytelling to a friend; the tone follows the meaning of the words: {MOOD}
body_short_default: Body: keeps moving with lively hand gestures that follow the meaning of the words; no pointing finger.

body_short.expert: Body: keeps moving with calm, purposeful explaining gestures of an expert that follow the meaning of the words; no winking, no hand on the hip, no pointing finger.

_sizing: v3 (2026-10-06, feedback): secs = words / art_wps (articulation rate measured on the approved hooks: speech time minus pauses) + 0.65 s per sentence break (Omni keeps ~0.6-0.7 s even when 0.3 is asked) + 0.6 s lead/tail + 0.5 s join for an extend. Pieces up to 10 s so the body is ONE chain (extend works fine with few iterations; same voice); sharpness is still checked per extend.
_base: base = the APPROVED HOOK prompt with the body text and a body delivery line (same prompt, text replaced, so the voice is the same); extends = shortened version of it.
_sizing_body: boy body base (11b6dd9f): 28 words, speech 0.18-7.9 s, sentence pause 0.31 s -> storytelling articulation 3.8 wps (hook 4.2), pause 0.35 (hook 0.65). The 8 s base fit with only 0.1 s tail.
_lead_tail_extend: boy body e1 (e3629e92): 23 words in 8 s -> 1.15 s pause + 'built around built around' (too loose). The extend's start is already covered by extend_join_s, so lead/tail for extends is 0.3, not 0.6 -> 7 s (23 words passed at 7 s three times).

ext_context.girl: Not spoken, background only: the character is an adult woman (about 28) in a simple cartoon style, in a light everyday talk about dating with her adult partner.

_extend_v3: boy e1 v2 (4855576a) SPOKE THE PROMPT: 'explaining my 30 ... texting dating style ... attachment st-' - words from the character/context lines placed right under the lipsync text. Extends: no character/context lines (girl: a 'not spoken, background only' line at the end, needed for moderation), plus 'says only these exact words'.
_expert_pace: expert base 993fbd42: 8 s for 28 words swallowed the last clause - the mature expert voice speaks ~3.4 wps with longer pauses; never copy another character's durations. Base 9 s (ffc81656) measured: 28 words, speech 0.16-8.64, pauses 0.38/0.33 -> 3.6 wps.
_chain_max: Kaleido adds a few ms per extend and floors the room left: a 40 s plan clamped the last piece 6 -> 5 s (expert). Plan <= 39 s.
_extend_input_max: Omni refuses to extend a clip longer than 30 s ('Videos longer than 30s are not supported for extension', expert e4 cc507668, no charge). A chain = pieces while the clip is <= 30 s, the last extend may take it to <= 39 s; the rest is a fresh clip from the character image with the BASE prompt (same voice line), cut at a sentence seam.
